notes: "You keep the AI client you already use. Codex and Claude Code load the HUANDENG plugin locally over MCP; DeepSeek uses it through its Harness; ChatGPT reaches the local editor through a command-line route. Whatever the client, every write goes through the same shared writer that the editor window uses. It checks that the agent read the current version, applies exactly the change that was previewed, and returns a receipt. So an agent cannot quietly overwrite something I changed a minute ago. This version of the talk was written by Claude Code along exactly this route."

designIntent.purpose: Show how AI clients reach the shared writer, as a labelled concept diagram.
keep: Official client marks from assets/brand, unaltered
Describe ChatGPT only as connecting to the local Editor
